title: Iterate a board's internal planes and read pull-back
summary: Walks the board's internal plane layers with IPCB_Board.InternalPlaneLayerIterator, casts each layer object to IPCB_InternalPlane_V7 and reports its name and pull-back distance in millimetres and internal units.
phrasings: list the plane layers of a board
get the pullback distance of a power plane
loop over internal planes in a PCB

commands.name: Iterator
commands.description: List the internal planes and their pull-back distance
